title: Left adjunct normalization for coefficient exchange
statement: Let ℓ be a prime, k a field of prime characteristic different from ℓ, E a finite coefficient subfield of Ω=PadicAlgCl(ℓ), and X,Y,X′,Y′ schemes separated of finite type over k. Let f:X→Y, g:Y′→Y, f′:X′→Y′, g′:X′→X be k-morphisms with sq:g′≫f=f′≫g. Write L_h^A,R_h^A and ε_h^A for the specified bounded constructible pullback, pushforward and counit for A=E or Ω (def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category). Write β_sq^A for its specified base-change map. Let T_Z:C_E(Z)→C_Ω(Z), α_h(V):T_T(L_h^E V)≅L_h^Ω(T_U V), and δ_h(K):T_U(R_h^E K)→R_h^Ω(T_T K) be exactly the coefficient functor and pull/push comparisons of def-weil-pbc-qbar-condensed-comparisons, for h:T→U. No properness or Cartesianity is assumed. For every K∈C_E(X), define S_K=α_g(R_f^E K).hom ≫ L_g^Ω(δ_f(K)). Then L_f′^Ω(S_K ≫ β_sq^Ω(T_X K)) ≫ ε_f′^Ω(L_g′^Ω(T_X K)) = α_f′(L_g^E(R_f^E K)).inv ≫ T_X′(L_f′^E(β_sq^E(K)) ≫ ε_f′^E(L_g′^E K)) ≫ α_g′(K).hom.

proof.text: Expand the left adjunct by functoriality. Use the base-change counit identity, then naturality of the Omega square comparison at the push comparison. The push-comparison counit identity follows from iterated mate cancellation and restriction along the fully faithful constructible inclusions. Substitute the pullback cube at Rf_E K. Naturality of alpha_g′ at the E counit and the E base-change counit identity produce the common middle expression. Reuse boundedConstructibleBaseChange_adjunct from the existing source module. Import and reuse constructibleToQbar_push_counit from the right module; that finite identity specializes the categorical lifted_push_counit theorem generalized there. It computes the pull and push comparisons from the extension/restriction adjunctions and comap isomorphism, so their mate identification is not assumed or reproved here. The remaining naturality and path combination helpers are proved privately.

theorem constructibleToQbar_exchange_left_adjunct
    (sq : CommSq g' f' f g) (K : PadicSubfieldConstructible X ℓ E) :
    (boundedConstructibleUpperStar (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) ℓ k f').map
      (constructibleToQbarSourceHom ℓ k E f g K ≫
        (boundedConstructibleBaseChange (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) ℓ k sq).app
          ((constructibleToPadicAlgCl X ℓ E).obj K)) ≫
      (boundedConstructibleUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction
        (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) ℓ k f').counit.app
          ((boundedConstructibleUpperStar (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) ℓ k g').obj
            ((constructibleToPadicAlgCl X ℓ E).obj K)) =
    (constructibleToQbarPullIso ℓ k E f'
        ((boundedConstructibleUpperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ k g).obj
          ((boundedConstructibleLowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ k f).obj K))).inv ≫
      (constructibleToPadicAlgCl X' ℓ E).map
        ((boundedConstructibleUpperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ k f').map
            ((boundedConstructibleBaseChange
              (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ k sq).app K) ≫
          (boundedConstructibleUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction
            (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ k f').counit.app
              ((boundedConstructibleUpperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ k g').obj K)) ≫
      (constructibleToQbarPullIso ℓ k E g' K).hom
